original_observation: Editable PowerPoint and Google Slides export limited to Pro/Team/Enterprise. PPT image-only alternative not editable. Animations/transitions absent in external exports. Missing fonts may shift layout.
limitations: Vendor specification, actual error frequency unmeasured.

original_observation: 2026 user reviews include examples of limited positioning customizations, PowerPoint text/borders/fonts needing correction, support and pricing concerns; others praise efficiency.
limitations: Self-selected review platform, not representative random sample; mentions are not occurrence rates.

original_observation: Official docs say PowerPoint Web has rendering limitations, generator has max 30 slides per presentation, uploading slides into file-to-deck rewrites/rearranges rather than preserves slides. Prompt is for content, not direct design customization.
limitations: May change. Technical claims are vendor-authored not tested.

original_observation: PPTX redesign limit 100 MB or 50 MB Free. AI 4 uses 1 credit per slide; AI 5 uses 5 credits. Redesign does not preserve existing animations. Import and redesign are distinct operations.
limitations: The document redesign is not identical to PDF to slides path.

original_observation: Premium, Premium Plus and Lifetime generally required for PPTX/PDF downloads; Translate-created decks exception. PPTX advertised editable text/shapes/tables/charts and notes; missing fonts can alter display.
limitations: Vendor claims of editability are not independent file-level tests.

original_observation: Privacy text states encrypted files kept by default 180 days, data not used for training, AI subprocessors utilized, cloud systems include Azure/AWS; ChatGPT integration stores preview images at unguessable public URLs and such previews can remain after slide deletion.
limitations: Vendor policy not security audit. Some retention subsections describe broader exceptions; further contract review required.

original_observation: PPTX export has three distinct modes: editable text, elements converted to images, single image per slide. Second/third modes are not fully editable, despite PPTX file extension. Commercial use permitted but redistribution of PPT templates prohibited.
limitations: Exact editable scope of charts/layout not independently tested; terms may be updated.

original_observation: Product homepage markets sourced PDF chatbot, multi-file chat, free plan with two documents/day, Plus plan, multiple formats including Word/PPTX/Markdown/plain text. Includes slide-related features in navigation.
limitations: Website self-description. Slide authoring scope not tested; free limits may change.

original_observation: PDF question-answer API uses source IDs and stateless chat; documented PDF limits 2,000 pages OR 32 MB per file. This is a PDF Q&A workflow, NOT evidence of editable slide generation.
limitations: Do not conflate PDF reading ability with producing editable PPTX. API tests unperformed.
